support_policy: Saved Tree(auto)/Default for support-enabled objects, including automatic normal sections. Explicit source or separate captive-group recipes can disable support locally.
physical_result: Unprinted; finish, removal effort and tactile fit are unmeasured.
transfer_limit: Coupon size changes cooling, perimeter length and layer return time. Physical references do not qualify complete product parts.

native.deposition_height_scope: Native LAYER_HEIGHT comments describe strand height, including 0.4 mm bridge strands. Per-object model_layer_steps_mm records the fixed model schedule.

object_model_deposition.deposition_height_scope: Strand heights include native bridge thickness; shared object Z steps describe the nominal layer schedule.
object_model_deposition.z_witness_scope: Explicit Z on depositing outer-wall moves witnesses native height ramps; it does not measure seam flatness.

native.support_gap_note: Requested Z distance is a slicer setting. Native layer quantization changes the commanded separation to the nominal roof underside. Strand-flow thickness, sag, removal and finish remain separate physical observations.

source_profile_reading.scope: Native positive extrusion moves attributed to standalone source objects or shared assembly objects. Model nozzle-Z steps, strand-flow heights, wall-lane counts, commanded wall feeds and feature order are observed separately from requested 3MF options. Per-layer feature sequences can contain multiple islands; first-wall order does not qualify every island. Physical bead shape, infill overlap, surface and strength are unmeasured.

specimens.local_wall_count_scope: No wall probe supplied; emitted local wall count has not been measured.
